title: GMKtec M3S AI Mini PC Intel Core 3 304 Max 4.3GHz 12GB LPDDR5 RAM 256GB SSD
writeup: This 256GB GMKtec M3S is a candidate for a small always-on home server: GMKtec lists two spare M.2 slots (up to 16TB combined), a 2.5GbE port and 15 to 25W power modes, and the minis-pc.com review calls file sharing, phone photo backups, DNS filtering and light containers a fit. The 12GB of RAM is soldered, so it cannot be upgraded, and there is only one Ethernet port, which rules out router or firewall duty. One r/HomeServer owner running the same Core 3 304 chip in another brand's box called it very quiet. We found no M3S-specific owner results yet, and no measured numbers.
